headline: Trump 🍊⏸️ Hits PAUSE on Iran 💥 to let Talks CHAT 💬🕊️
text: Trump 🍊👑 straight-up GHOSTED the airstrikes ✈️💣 for TWO NIGHTS 🌙🌙 so diplomacy could SLIDE IN 🕺💬, UN ambassador Mike Waltz 🕴️🎙️ told Fox News 🦊📺. 'He's giving talks some SPACE 🪐, a little ROOM 🛋️,' said Waltz, basically telling the world to CHILL 😎. Iran also hit the BRAKES 🛑 on retaliatory strikes, turning the Strait of Hormuz ⚓ into a weirdly quiet DANCE FLOOR 🕺💃 after weeks of tit-for-tat BEEFS 🥩🔥. Oil prices? They SKYROCKETED 🚀 to $100 a barrel 🛢️, making gas pumps 😭😭 and wallets CRY 💸. Meanwhile, Iran and Oman are TALKING TECH 🗣️🛠️ in Tehran about who gets to DJ the strait 🎧🚢. Wes Streeting 🇬🇧🕴️ is flying to meet Pete Hegseth 🇺🇸🥊 next week to keep the shipping lanes OPEN 🔓. Trump still posted AI-generated 🔥 pics of US planes BOMBING ships on Truth Social, proving he's keeping EVERY OPTION on the TABLE 🍽️, not just the olive branch 🫒. Poll shows most Americans are OVER IT 😩, but the war's still raging on like a bad reality show 📺💥. Netanyahu's heading to the White House for a Tuesday face-to-face 🤝, so the drama ain't over yet!
